statement: The function returns a result r, and r is the least integer k with 1 <= k <= len(capacity) for which there exists a set B of indices into capacity such that |B| = k and sum_{j in B} capacity[j] >= S. Equivalently, r boxes suffice to hold all apples, and no smaller positive number of boxes suffices.
preconditions: Let S = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple)-1} apple[i]. The inputs satisfy 1 <= len(apple) <= 50, 1 <= len(capacity) <= 50, 1 <= apple[i] <= 50 for every i with 0 <= i < len(apple), 1 <= capacity[j] <= 50 for every j with 0 <= j < len(capacity), and S <= sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j].

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: Let S = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple)-1} apple[i]. The inputs satisfy 1 <= len(apple) <= 50, 1 <= len(capacity) <= 50, 1 <= apple[i] <= 50 for every i with 0 <= i < len(apple), 1 <= capacity[j] <= 50 for every j with 0 <= j < len(capacity), and S <= sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j].

statement: The function returns a result r and 1 <= r <= len(capacity).
preconditions: Let S = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple)-1} apple[i]. The inputs satisfy 1 <= len(apple) <= 50, 1 <= len(capacity) <= 50, 1 <= apple[i] <= 50 for every i with 0 <= i < len(apple), 1 <= capacity[j] <= 50 for every j with 0 <= j < len(capacity), and S <= sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j].

statement: The function returns a result r and there exists a set B of indices into capacity with |B| = r and sum_{j in B} capacity[j] >= S.
preconditions: Let S = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple)-1} apple[i]. The inputs satisfy 1 <= len(apple) <= 50, 1 <= len(capacity) <= 50, 1 <= apple[i] <= 50 for every i with 0 <= i < len(apple), 1 <= capacity[j] <= 50 for every j with 0 <= j < len(capacity), and S <= sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j].

statement: The function returns a result r and every set B of indices into capacity with |B| < r satisfies sum_{j in B} capacity[j] < S.
preconditions: Let S = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple)-1} apple[i]. The inputs satisfy 1 <= len(apple) <= 50, 1 <= len(capacity) <= 50, 1 <= apple[i] <= 50 for every i with 0 <= i < len(apple), 1 <= capacity[j] <= 50 for every j with 0 <= j < len(capacity), and S <= sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j].

statement: The function returns a result r, and r = 1 if and only if there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(capacity) and capacity[j] >= S.
preconditions: Let S = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple)-1} apple[i]. The inputs satisfy 1 <= len(apple) <= 50, 1 <= len(capacity) <= 50, 1 <= apple[i] <= 50 for every i with 0 <= i < len(apple), 1 <= capacity[j] <= 50 for every j with 0 <= j < len(capacity), and S <= sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j].

statement: Let C = sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j] and let cmin = min_{0 <= j < len(capacity)} capacity[j], which is well-defined because len(capacity) >= 1. The function returns a result r, and r = len(capacity) if and only if C - cmin < S.
preconditions: Let S = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple)-1} apple[i]. The inputs satisfy 1 <= len(apple) <= 50, 1 <= len(capacity) <= 50, 1 <= apple[i] <= 50 for every i with 0 <= i < len(apple), 1 <= capacity[j] <= 50 for every j with 0 <= j < len(capacity), and S <= sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j].

statement: Let Cmax = max_{0 <= j < len(capacity)} capacity[j]. The function returns a result r and r * Cmax >= S.
preconditions: Let S = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple)-1} apple[i]. The inputs satisfy 1 <= len(apple) <= 50, 1 <= len(capacity) <= 50, 1 <= apple[i] <= 50 for every i with 0 <= i < len(apple), 1 <= capacity[j] <= 50 for every j with 0 <= j < len(capacity), and S <= sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j].

statement: Whenever minimum_boxes apple1 capacity returns r1 and minimum_boxes apple2 capacity returns r2, we have r1 <= r2.
preconditions: Let apple1 and apple2 be any two slices satisfying 1 <= len(apple1) <= 50, 1 <= len(apple2) <= 50, and all their entries lie in [1,50]. Let S1 = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple1)-1} apple1[i] and S2 = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple2)-1} apple2[i]. Assume S1 <= S2 and S2 <= sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j], where capacity satisfies 1 <= len(capacity) <= 50 and all its entries lie in [1,50].

statement: Whenever minimum_boxes apple1 capacity returns r1 and minimum_boxes apple2 capacity returns r2, we have r1 = r2.
preconditions: Let apple1 and apple2 be any two slices satisfying 1 <= len(apple1) <= 50, 1 <= len(apple2) <= 50, and all their entries lie in [1,50]. Let S = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple1)-1} apple1[i] = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple2)-1} apple2[i]. Assume S <= sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j], where capacity satisfies 1 <= len(capacity) <= 50 and all its entries lie in [1,50].

statement: Whenever minimum_boxes apple capacity returns r and minimum_boxes apple capacity' returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: Let capacity' be a slice with len(capacity') = len(capacity) that is a permutation of capacity: there is a bijection f from {0,...,len(capacity)-1} to itself such that capacity'[i] = capacity[f(i)] for every i. Let apple satisfy 1 <= len(apple) <= 50 with all entries in [1,50], and let S = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple)-1} apple[i] <= sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j]. Also capacity satisfies 1 <= len(capacity) <= 50 with all entries in [1,50].

statement: Whenever minimum_boxes apple capacity1 returns r1 and minimum_boxes apple capacity2 returns r2, we have r2 <= r1.
preconditions: Let capacity1 and capacity2 be slices of the same length m with 1 <= m <= 50, all entries in [1,50], and capacity1[j] <= capacity2[j] for every j with 0 <= j < m. Let apple satisfy 1 <= len(apple) <= 50 with all entries in [1,50], and let S = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple)-1} apple[i]. Assume S <= sum_{j=0}^{m-1} capacity1[j].

statement: Let c1 >= c2 >= ... >= cm be the values capacity[0],...,capacity[m-1] sorted in nonincreasing order, where m = len(capacity). The function returns a result r and sum_{i=1}^{r} ci >= S.
preconditions: Let S = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple)-1} apple[i]. The inputs satisfy 1 <= len(apple) <= 50, 1 <= len(capacity) <= 50, 1 <= apple[i] <= 50 for every i with 0 <= i < len(apple), 1 <= capacity[j] <= 50 for every j with 0 <= j < len(capacity), and S <= sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j].

statement: Let c1 >= c2 >= ... >= cm be the values capacity[0],...,capacity[m-1] sorted in nonincreasing order, where m = len(capacity). The function returns a result r and sum_{i=1}^{r-1} ci < S, with the convention that the empty sum when r = 1 is 0.
preconditions: Let S = sum_{i=0}^{len(apple)-1} apple[i]. The inputs satisfy 1 <= len(apple) <= 50, 1 <= len(capacity) <= 50, 1 <= apple[i] <= 50 for every i with 0 <= i < len(apple), 1 <= capacity[j] <= 50 for every j with 0 <= j < len(capacity), and S <= sum_{j=0}^{len(capacity)-1} capacity[j].
